newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-YANKEES PLACE RAINES ON DISABLED LIST.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-YANKEES PLACE RAINES ON DISABLED LIST.

text.p: New York Yankees outfielder Tim Raines, who was forced to leave Sunday's game against the Boston Red Sox due to a strained left hamstring, was placed on the 15-day disabled list on Tuesday, retroactive to Sunday.
Second baseman Pat Kelly was activated from the disabled list to take the place of Raines on the roster of the defending World Series champions.

Raines suffered the injury while running the bases in the ninth inning and returns to the DL for the second time this year. He began the year on a rehab assignment due to a hamstring injury and missed the first two weeks of the season.
Raines became the regular left fielder when Darryl Strawberry went down with a knee injury and is hitting .305 with one homer and 17 RBI so far this season.
Mark Whiten is hitting .315 with five homers and is a likely candidate to replace Raines, but is considered a defensive liability.
Raines, limited to 59 games last season because of hamstring problems, hit .284 with nine homers and 33 RBI for the Yankees in 1996.
